news.title: Breaking: Football great Lionel Messi announces retirement from Argentina team
news.lede: Argentinian captain Lionel Messi is considered one of the world's best football players. (Reuters: Agustin Marcarian). Football great Lionel Messi has announced he will retire from the Argentinian team. The announcement comes less than a month after the death of his father Jorge.

news.title: Lionel Messi Makes Final Retirement Decision as He Releases Emotional Statement
news.lede: Lionel Messi has made his final decision on retiring from representing Argentina following the 2026 World Cup, marking the end of one of the greatest international careers in history. Messi, 39, was one game away from winning back-to-back World Cups, but had to settle for the second silver medal of his career as Argentina fell short against Spain in July. The greatest footballer of all time was widely expected to retire from international duty after the heartbreak of losing the World Cup final and then his father's tragic passing just weeks later. Messi has now posted a lengthy statement, which he wrote just two days after the defeat to Spain at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey.

news.title: Argentina’s Lionel Messi retires from international football: ‘This hurts me a lot’
news.lede: Argentina great’s last game was in World Cup final. Player’s father Jorge passed away earlier in August. Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international duty with Argentina after winning 207 caps. Messi, who made his Argentina debut in 2005, won the World Cup in 2022 and was a runner-up this summer and in 2014.

news.title: Messi retires from international football with incredible goal record
news.lede: One of the world's greatest players has called time on his international playing career with his final game being the World Cup final defeat to Spain in New York. Messi scored 125 goals in 207 appearances for Argentina including eight goals at this summer's World Cup. The 39-year-old has 21 World Cup goals in all, second only to Kylian Mbappe in the all-time charts. Along with Cristiano Ronaldo, he is one of the greatest goal scorers of all time and he leaves the national team having won the World Cup in a 21-year career.
